verdict.rationale: The security FAQ documents a default 30-day retention policy and a self-serve Zero Data Retention option, toggled per team in Team Settings, under which prompts and outputs are never persisted to disk. Every API response also carries an `x-zero-data-retention` header, so users can confirm the setting programmatically. Missing for 10: explicit controls for deleting already-stored data (e.g., uploaded files, collections, cached prompts) or configurable retention periods beyond ZDR on/off, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
